title: Sound level falling with distance
caption: Spreading over a sphere, intensity falls as 1/r², so the level drops 20 log₁₀(r₂/r₁) dB: 6 dB for each doubling of distance. Ten times further, from 2 m to 20 m, the 80 dB falls by 20 dB to 60 dB.
alt: Sound level in decibels against distance: falling quickly near the speaker and more slowly further away, from 80 at 2 metres to 60 at 20 metres.
description: Level L = 80 − 20 log₁₀(r / 2 m) dB, for spherical spreading only.
At 4 m: 74 dB. At 8 m: 68 dB. Each doubling of distance costs 6 dB.
